case_definition 中的边界区域名称由网格节点生成并固定为 inlet、outlet、cylinder、top 和 bottom，其中 top 与 bottom 组成远场壁面集合。

import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from cgraph.library import DataPort, ExeNodeType, FlowPort


class Cylinder2dParametricGeometry(ExeNodeType):
    id = "cylinder2d_parametric_geometry"
    version = "0.1.0"
    source = "cylinder2d_parametric_geometry"
    display_name = "参数化二维圆柱几何生成"
    description = "根据圆柱直径、位置和计算域尺寸生成二维圆柱绕流计算域几何文件，并定义入口、出口、上下边界及圆柱壁面区域。"
    category = "geometry.model"
    receive = (FlowPort(name="upstream"),)
    send = (FlowPort(name="downstream"),)
    inputs = (
        DataPort(
            name="cylinder_diameter",
            dtype="float",
            display_name="圆柱直径",
            description="圆柱直径。",
            semantic_type="geometry.diameter",
            unit="length",
        ),
        DataPort(
            name="cylinder_x",
            dtype="float",
            display_name="圆柱 X 坐标",
            description="圆柱圆心 X 坐标。",
            semantic_type="geometry.point2d.x",
            unit="length",
        ),
        DataPort(
            name="cylinder_y",
            dtype="float",
            display_name="圆柱 Y 坐标",
            description="圆柱圆心 Y 坐标。",
            semantic_type="geometry.point2d.y",
            unit="length",
        ),
        DataPort(
            name="domain_length",
            dtype="float",
            display_name="计算域长度",
            description="计算域 X 方向总长度。",
            semantic_type="geometry.domain.length",
            unit="length",
        ),
        DataPort(
            name="domain_height",
            dtype="float",
            display_name="计算域高度",
            description="计算域 Y 方向总高度。",
            semantic_type="geometry.domain.height",
            unit="length",
        ),
        DataPort(
            name="output_directory",
            dtype="string",
            display_name="输出目录",
            description="用于保存参数化几何产物的目录。",
            semantic_type="filesystem.directory",
        ),
    )
    outputs = (
        DataPort(
            name="geometry_file",
            dtype="file",
            display_name="二维计算域几何",
            description="包含圆柱和外部计算域边界分区的参数化二维几何文件。",
            semantic_type="geometry.model.file",
            extensions={
                "artifact_contract": {
                    "format": "cylinder2d_parametric_geometry_v1"
                }
            },
        ),
        DataPort(
            name="boundary_metadata",
            dtype="dict",
            display_name="边界区域元数据",
            description="几何边界名称、类型和拓扑标识。",
            semantic_type="geometry.boundary.metadata",
        ),
    )

    @staticmethod
    def run(
        cylinder_diameter,
        cylinder_x,
        cylinder_y,
        domain_length,
        domain_height,
        output_directory,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        numeric_inputs = {
            "cylinder_diameter": cylinder_diameter,
            "cylinder_x": cylinder_x,
            "cylinder_y": cylinder_y,
            "domain_length": domain_length,
            "domain_height": domain_height,
        }
        for name, value in numeric_inputs.items():
            if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
                raise ValueError(f"{name} dtype must be float")
            if not math.isfinite(float(value)):
                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite")

        if float(cylinder_diameter) <= 0.0:
            raise ValueError("cylinder_diameter must be greater than zero")
        if float(domain_length) <= 0.0:
            raise ValueError("domain_length must be greater than zero")
        if float(domain_height) <= 0.0:
            raise ValueError("domain_height must be greater than zero")
        if not isinstance(output_directory, str):
            raise ValueError("output_directory dtype must be string")
        if not output_directory.strip():
            raise ValueError("output_directory must not be empty")

        diameter = float(cylinder_diameter)
        center_x = float(cylinder_x)
        center_y = float(cylinder_y)
        length = float(domain_length)
        height = float(domain_height)
        radius = diameter / 2.0

        x_min = -length / 2.0
        x_max = length / 2.0
        y_min = -height / 2.0
        y_max = height / 2.0

        if center_x - radius <= x_min:
            raise ValueError("cylinder intersects or crosses the inlet boundary")
        if center_x + radius >= x_max:
            raise ValueError("cylinder intersects or crosses the outlet boundary")
        if center_y - radius <= y_min:
            raise ValueError("cylinder intersects or crosses the bottom boundary")
        if center_y + radius >= y_max:
            raise ValueError("cylinder intersects or crosses the top boundary")

        boundaries = {
            "inlet": {
                "name": "inlet",
                "type": "velocity_inlet",
                "topology_id": "edge:outer:left",
                "geometry": {
                    "kind": "line_segment",
                    "start": [x_min, y_min],
                    "end": [x_min, y_max],
                    "length": height,
                },
            },
            "outlet": {
                "name": "outlet",
                "type": "pressure_outlet",
                "topology_id": "edge:outer:right",
                "geometry": {
                    "kind": "line_segment",
                    "start": [x_max, y_min],
                    "end": [x_max, y_max],
                    "length": height,
                },
            },
            "top": {
                "name": "top",
                "type": "farfield",
                "topology_id": "edge:outer:top",
                "geometry": {
                    "kind": "line_segment",
                    "start": [x_min, y_max],
                    "end": [x_max, y_max],
                    "length": length,
                },
            },
            "bottom": {
                "name": "bottom",
                "type": "farfield",
                "topology_id": "edge:outer:bottom",
                "geometry": {
                    "kind": "line_segment",
                    "start": [x_min, y_min],
                    "end": [x_max, y_min],
                    "length": length,
                },
            },
            "cylinder_wall": {
                "name": "cylinder_wall",
                "type": "wall",
                "topology_id": "edge:hole:cylinder",
                "geometry": {
                    "kind": "circle",
                    "center": [center_x, center_y],
                    "radius": radius,
                    "circumference": math.pi * diameter,
                },
            },
        }

        outer_area = length * height
        cylinder_area = math.pi * radius * radius
        fluid_area = outer_area - cylinder_area
        geometry = {
            "format": "cylinder2d_parametric_geometry_v1",
            "dimension": 2,
            "coordinate_system": "cartesian",
            "domain": {
                "kind": "rectangle_with_circular_hole",
                "bounds": {
                    "x_min": x_min,
                    "x_max": x_max,
                    "y_min": y_min,
                    "y_max": y_max,
                },
                "length": length,
                "height": height,
                "outer_area": outer_area,
                "fluid_area": fluid_area,
            },
            "cylinder": {
                "center": [center_x, center_y],
                "diameter": diameter,
                "radius": radius,
                "area": cylinder_area,
            },
            "boundaries": boundaries,
        }
        content = json.dumps(
            geometry,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            sort_keys=True,
            separators=(",", ":"),
            allow_nan=False,
        )

        output_root = Path(output_directory)
        try:
            output_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            output_path = output_root / "cylinder2d_geometry.json"
            with output_path.open(mode="w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
                stream.write(content)
        except OSError as exc:

        geometry_file = {
            "filename": "cylinder2d_geometry.json",
            "content": content,
            "encoding": "utf-8",
            "suffix": ".json",
        }

from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from executor.cylinder2d_parametric_geometry import Cylinder2dParametricGeometry


def valid_inputs(tmp_path: Path) -> dict:
    return {
        "cylinder_diameter": 1.0,
        "cylinder_x": 2.0,
        "cylinder_y": 0.0,
        "domain_length": 20.0,
        "domain_height": 10.0,
        "output_directory": str(tmp_path),
    }


def test_run_returns_confirmed_outputs(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    inputs = valid_inputs(tmp_path)
    result = Cylinder2dParametricGeometry.run(**inputs)

    assert set(result) == {"geometry_file", "boundary_metadata"}
    artifact = result["geometry_file"]
    assert set(artifact) == {"filename", "content", "encoding", "suffix"}
    assert artifact["filename"] == "cylinder2d_geometry.json"
    assert artifact["encoding"] == "utf-8"
    assert artifact["suffix"] == ".json"
    assert isinstance(artifact["content"], str)

    geometry = json.loads(artifact["content"])
    assert geometry["format"] == "cylinder2d_parametric_geometry_v1"
    assert geometry["dimension"] == 2
    assert geometry["domain"]["bounds"] == {
        "x_min": -10.0,
        "x_max": 10.0,
        "y_min": -5.0,
        "y_max": 5.0,
    }
    assert geometry["cylinder"]["center"] == [2.0, 0.0]
    assert geometry["cylinder"]["diameter"] == 1.0
    assert geometry["domain"]["fluid_area"] == pytest.approx(
        200.0 - pytest.approx(3.141592653589793 * 0.25)
    )

    expected_boundaries = {"inlet", "outlet", "top", "bottom", "cylinder_wall"}
    assert set(result["boundary_metadata"]) == expected_boundaries
    assert set(geometry["boundaries"]) == expected_boundaries
    assert geometry["boundaries"] == result["boundary_metadata"]

    written_path = tmp_path / "cylinder2d_geometry.json"
    assert written_path.is_file()
    assert written_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == artifact["content"]


def test_output_is_deterministic(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    first_directory = tmp_path / "first"
    second_directory = tmp_path / "second"
    first_inputs = valid_inputs(first_directory)
    second_inputs = valid_inputs(second_directory)

    first = Cylinder2dParametricGeometry.run(**first_inputs)
    second = Cylinder2dParametricGeometry.run(**second_inputs)

    assert first["geometry_file"] == second["geometry_file"]
    assert first["boundary_metadata"] == second["boundary_metadata"]
